title: Introduce RAG rewrite-simulator and toolchain sandbox with VSCode snippets
author: Maya Thompson
release_notes: Adds a lightweight RAG rewrite simulator and an interactive toolchain sandbox intended for authoring and iterating on retrieval+rewrite flows. Includes VSCode snippet pack and a docs quickstart. Non-breaking; example artifacts only.
description: Motivation: teams frequently need to iterate on how retrieved context is rewritten/filtered before being fed to the model. Existing examples focus on orchestration and evaluation; there wasn't a compact, replay-driven playground for testing rewrite heuristics and tool-calling sequences. This PR introduces a small, browser-friendly simulator that replays retrieval hits, lets engineers author rewrite rules (JS + declarative filters), and runs step assertions to validate intended behavior. The goal is a fast feedback loop for prompt/rewriter design and tool-binding sequences that integrates with the docs site and VSCode snippets for quick onboarding. What this PR provides: 1) rag-rewrite-sim/ - a micro sandbox (static bundle + small Node-based dev server) that accepts JSON replay traces and lets you step through retrieval->rewrite->tool-call sequences. 2) examples/rewrite-presets/ - a curated set of rewrite rule presets (fuzzy filter, length-priority, metadata-scoring). 3) vscode/snippets/rag-rewrite.code-snippets - snippet pack for quick authoring of rewrite hooks and tool-call handlers in TypeScript. 4) docs/quickstarts/rag-rewrite-simulator.md - quickstart with screenshots, usage, and recommended test assertions. 5) test/fixtures/replay-traces/ - three small traces used in CI smoke tests. 6) a lightweight GitHub Actions workflow to run the simulator smoke tests in headless mode. Checklist: - [x] Simulator UI with stepper and inspector - [x] Replay trace loader + seed traces - [x] Preset rewrite rules and sample tool-call stubs - [x] VSCode snippet pack and README - [x] Docs quickstart and screenshots - [x] CI smoke test for headless replay run - [x] Accessibility basics (keyboard stepper) How to try locally: 1) git checkout feature/rag-rewrite-sim-sandbox 2) cd rag-rewrite-sim && yarn && yarn dev 3) open http://localhost:3002 and load a trace from examples/replay-traces/ 4) open vscode and add the snippets: Preferences: Configure User Snippets -> select the workspace and paste vscode/snippets/rag-rewrite.code-snippets Design notes: the simulator intentionally avoids any heavy runtime or model inference. Rewrites are pure JS transforms that can be run in a VM sandbox (vm2) or evaluated with an isolated worker; we opted for a restricted subset and runtime checks for safety. The UI is framework-agnostic (vanilla TS + lit-html) to keep the bundle small and embeddable in docs. Security: the simulator never calls external APIs in CI; all tool-call stubs are no-ops and surfaced only as simulated events. Related work: builds on concepts from the replay replayer and the authoring studio but focuses specifically on rewrite engineering and quick tool-binding tests. Links: internal doc: https://internal.redwood.dev/ENG-1284 (private) and Linear ENG-1284. Merge rationale: small, opinionated example that accelerates developer onboarding for RAG rewrite patterns and helps prevent regressions in rewriting logic across model upgrades.
